name: google-gsc-mcp

tools.name: wsp_show_status_gsc
tools.description: List every tool this server offers, grouped by category, with the current authentication status. Call it first to learn what is available or to diagnose login problems.

tools.name: wsp_list_websites_gsc
tools.description: List every Search Console property (domain and URL-prefix) the connected account can access. Returns the exact site_url string every other tool requires.

tools.name: wsp_add_website_gsc
tools.description: Add a property to Search Console. Requires WSP_ALLOW_WRITES=true.

site_url.description: The URL of the site (must be exact match e.g. https://example.com, or https://www.example.com, or https://subdomain.example.com/path/, for domain properties use format: sc-domain:example.com)

tools.name: wsp_remove_website_gsc
tools.description: Remove a property from Search Console. Requires WSP_ALLOW_WRITES=true.

site_url.description: The URL of the site (must be exact match e.g. https://example.com, or https://www.example.com, or https://subdomain.example.com/path/, for domain properties use format: sc-domain:example.com)

tools.name: wsp_show_website_gsc
tools.description: Permission level, verification and ownership details for one property.

site_url.description: Exact GSC property URL from wsp_list_websites_gsc (e.g. "https://example.com/" or "sc-domain:example.com"). Domain properties cover all subdomains — use the domain property as site_url and filter by page to analyze a specific subdomain.

tools.name: wsp_check_url_gsc
tools.description: Check a URL's index status, last crawl, canonical, robots and rich results as Google sees it.

site_url.description: Exact GSC property URL from wsp_list_websites_gsc (e.g. "https://example.com/" or "sc-domain:example.com"). Domain properties cover all subdomains — use the domain property as site_url and filter by page to analyze a specific subdomain.

tools.name: wsp_check_urls_gsc
tools.description: Inspect up to 10 URLs in one call (run concurrently). Same data as wsp_check_url_gsc, one row per URL.

site_url.description: Exact GSC property URL from wsp_list_websites_gsc (e.g. "https://example.com/" or "sc-domain:example.com"). Domain properties cover all subdomains — use the domain property as site_url and filter by page to analyze a specific subdomain.

urls.description: List of URLs to inspect, one per line (max 10)

tools.name: wsp_show_traffic_gsc
tools.description: Totals (clicks, impressions, CTR, position) and a daily trend for the last N days.

site_url.description: Exact GSC property URL from wsp_list_websites_gsc (e.g. "https://example.com/" or "sc-domain:example.com"). Domain properties cover all subdomains — use the domain property as site_url and filter by page to analyze a specific subdomain.

days.description: Number of days to look back (default: 28)

tools.name: wsp_run_report_gsc
tools.description: Flexible search analytics: choose dimensions, date range, search type, filters, sorting and pagination (up to 25,000 rows).

site_url.description: Exact GSC property URL from wsp_list_websites_gsc (e.g. "https://example.com/" or "sc-domain:example.com"). Domain properties cover all subdomains — use the domain property as site_url and filter by page to analyze a specific subdomain.

start_date.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to 28 days ago)

end_date.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to today)

search_type.description: Type of search results (WEB, IMAGE, VIDEO, NEWS, DISCOVER)

row_limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return (max 25000)

sort_by.description: Metric to sort by (clicks, impressions, ctr, position). Applied client-side to the returned rows, since Google only sorts by clicks.

sort_direction.description: Sort direction (ascending or descending). For position, ascending puts the best (lowest) average position first.

filter_dimension.description: Single filter dimension (query, page, country, device). Use 'filters' instead for multiple filters.

filter_operator.description: Single filter operator (contains, equals, notContains, notEquals)

filters.description: JSON array of filter objects for AND logic across multiple dimensions. Overrides filter_dimension/filter_operator/filter_expression when provided. Each object must have 'dimension', 'operator', and 'expression' keys. Valid dimensions: query, page, country, device. Valid operators: contains, equals, notContains, notEquals. Example: [{"dimension":"country","operator":"equals","expression":"usa"},{"dimension":"device","operator":"equals","expression":"MOBILE"}]

data_state.description: Data freshness — "all" (default, matches GSC dashboard) or "final" (confirmed data only, 2-3 day lag)

tools.name: wsp_compare_dates_gsc
tools.description:
Compare search performance across two date ranges.

Direction: Period 1 is the period you are analyzing and Period 2 is the baseline you compare it against. All deltas are Period 1 relative to Period 2, and the percentage baseline is Period 2. A positive value means Period 1 outperformed Period 2 — more clicks/impressions, higher CTR, or a better (lower) average position. For a current-vs-previous comparison, pass the current period as Period 1 and the previous period as Period 2. Percentages are null when the Period 2 baseline is zero.

site_url.description: Exact GSC property URL from wsp_list_websites_gsc (e.g. "https://example.com/" or "sc-domain:example.com"). Domain properties cover all subdomains — use the domain property as site_url and filter by page to analyze a specific subdomain.

period1_start.description: Start date for period 1 / the analyzed period (YYYY-MM-DD)

period1_end.description: End date for period 1 / the analyzed period (YYYY-MM-DD)

period2_start.description: Start date for period 2 / the baseline period (YYYY-MM-DD)

period2_end.description: End date for period 2 / the baseline period (YYYY-MM-DD)

limit.description: Number of top results to compare (default: 10)

tools.name: wsp_find_page_keywords_gsc
tools.description: Queries that drove clicks and impressions to one specific page.

site_url.description: Exact GSC property URL from wsp_list_websites_gsc (e.g. "https://example.com/" or "sc-domain:example.com"). Domain properties cover all subdomains — use the domain property as site_url and filter by page to analyze a specific subdomain.

page_url.description: The specific page URL to analyze

days.description: Number of days to look back (default: 28)

row_limit.description: Number of rows to return (default: 20, max: 500). Use 5-20 for quick overviews, 50-200 for deeper analysis, up to 500 for comprehensive reports. For bulk exports beyond 500 rows, use wsp_run_report_gsc which supports pagination.

tools.name: wsp_show_sitemaps_gsc
tools.description: List submitted sitemaps with status, URL counts, errors and warnings. Pass sitemap_index to list an index's children.

site_url.description: Exact GSC property URL from wsp_list_websites_gsc (e.g. "https://example.com/" or "sc-domain:example.com"). Domain properties cover all subdomains — use the domain property as site_url and filter by page to analyze a specific subdomain.

sitemap_index.description: Optional sitemap index URL to list child sitemaps

tools.name: wsp_show_sitemap_gsc
tools.description: Full status and per-content-type breakdown for one sitemap.

site_url.description: Exact GSC property URL from wsp_list_websites_gsc (e.g. "https://example.com/" or "sc-domain:example.com"). Domain properties cover all subdomains — use the domain property as site_url and filter by page to analyze a specific subdomain.

sitemap_url.description: The full URL of the sitemap to inspect

tools.name: wsp_add_sitemap_gsc
tools.description: Submit or resubmit a sitemap. Requires WSP_ALLOW_WRITES=true.

site_url.description: Exact GSC property URL from wsp_list_websites_gsc (e.g. "https://example.com/" or "sc-domain:example.com"). Domain properties cover all subdomains — use the domain property as site_url and filter by page to analyze a specific subdomain.

sitemap_url.description: The full URL of the sitemap to submit

tools.name: wsp_remove_sitemap_gsc
tools.description: Unsubmit a sitemap. Already-indexed URLs stay indexed. Requires WSP_ALLOW_WRITES=true.

site_url.description: Exact GSC property URL from wsp_list_websites_gsc (e.g. "https://example.com/" or "sc-domain:example.com"). Domain properties cover all subdomains — use the domain property as site_url and filter by page to analyze a specific subdomain.

sitemap_url.description: The full URL of the sitemap to delete

tools.name: wsp_login_again_gsc
tools.description: Delete the saved OAuth token and open a browser login. Use it to switch Google accounts, fix auth errors, or apply a changed WSP_ALLOW_WRITES setting.

instructions: Google Search Console tools for SEO analysis. Call wsp_show_status_gsc first for the tool list and auth status, then wsp_list_websites_gsc to get the exact site_url (e.g. 'https://example.com/' or 'sc-domain:example.com') every other tool needs. Search analytics are sorted by clicks and capped per request; URL inspection tools accept at most 10 URLs per call. Write operations (wsp_add_website_gsc, wsp_remove_website_gsc, wsp_add_sitemap_gsc, wsp_remove_sitemap_gsc) are disabled unless WSP_ALLOW_WRITES=true.
